steps: Open the production game at http://127.0.0.1:5214/ using Chrome.
Complete original puzzle 1 through public controls and reload to verify persistence.
Select puzzle 5 through its public collection button.
Click every square in rows 4 and 5, the four center squares in rows 1, 2, 3, and 6.
Right-click the six empty squares in row 1 to mark crosses.
Observe 36 fills, six crosses and incomplete status. Capture the unedited browser page.
notes: Real local production gameplay, public-control input only. Original JPEG browser screenshot bytes retained without image editing. Full-page height may exceed the 1000px viewport. Browser extension warnings were unrelated to the game.
